topic: Counselor Mapping: Round Robin Lead Assignment
summary: Counselor Mapping allows for the automatic assignment of incoming leads to counselors based on specific courses or sources. The system uses a 'Round Robin' method, which can be configured in two ways: 'All' (for load balancing) or 'Devise' (for sequential assignment).
steps: 1. Navigate to Admission Setup > Admission Master > Counselor Mapper.
2. Select the specific courses or sources for which leads should be automatically assigned.
3. Select the counselors who will receive these leads.
4. Choose the desired Round Robin method: 'All' or 'Devise'.
business_rules: Leads from the selected courses/sources will be automatically assigned to the chosen counselors.

Round Robin 'All' method: If a new counselor joins, the system will first assign leads to them until their lead count balances with existing counselors. Once balanced, leads are assigned one-by-one to all counselors.
Round Robin 'Devise' method: Leads are assigned strictly one-by-one in a sequential order to all counselors, regardless of their current lead load or when they joined the system.
important_notes: Counselor mapping eliminates the need for manual lead assignment, ensuring efficient distribution.
The 'All' method is ideal for ensuring an equitable distribution of leads over time.
The 'Devise' method ensures a strict rotational assignment.
